Method of Attack: Exploiting VMware vCenter Server web client vulnerability CVE-2021-21972 for initial access
Extracting administrative credentials from target server
Using RDP over SSH for lateral movement
Using WinRAR to archive stolen files with password protection
Encrypting archive passwords and deleting original files
Using Jetico’s BCWipe to delete traces
Using Python-based ransomware for AES encryption (initial attempts)
Bypassing anti-ransomware detection by moving files into password-protected WinRAR archives instead of encrypting files directly
Attack Vector: Exploitation of unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability CVE-2021-21972 on TCP/IP port 443
Indicators of Compromise: Use of WinRAR archives with .vaultz file extension
Ransom note demanding 15.95 BTC or 0.099 BTC per file
PowerShell commands to install XMR miners (by different actor exploiting same vulnerability)
